newsitem.title: FINLAND: CS FIRST BOSTON HAS "HOLD" ON KEMIRA.
newsitem.headline: CS FIRST BOSTON HAS "HOLD" ON KEMIRA.

text.p: CS First Boston is recommending "hold" for Finnish state-controlled chemicals group Kemira Oy after its recent share issue, CSFB said in a research dated on November 4.

"Though Kemira's operations are likely to show solid performance over the next few years -- assuming recovery in Pigments -- when account is taken of the dilution from the new shares in issue, the stock appears fairly valued at current levels," CSFB said, but did not say what its earlier Kemira recommendations had been.
CSFB put Kemira's earnings per share at 4.63 markka in 1996, at 5.63 markka in 1997 and at 5.66 markka in 1998, up from 4.55 markka in 1995.
